metadata.case_name: LEUNG HO MIMI v. MORNING CORPORATION LTD

source: Medical examination found that the Plaintiff suffered fracture of right pubic rami.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of pubis without disruption of pelvic ring

source: Further X-ray revealed that besides the fracture of right pubic rami there was also a fracture of the right ilium and both fractures healed up with mild deformity.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of ilium without disruption of pelvic ring

manifestations.description: right hip pain and weakness rendering it necessary for her to walk with a stick
required bed rest at home until November 2004
began to walk with crutches at home four months after the accident
in the first two months she could not get out of bed at all
uses a wheelchair for a period of time and used a walking frame
now uses a stick to assist her when walking outside her home
feels uncomfortable and painful if she changed her posture from sitting to standing up or if she sat or stood for more than 15 minutes
feels pain in her pelvic area when she made any body movement from time to time and especially when the weather changes
slight decrease of right hip movement
walked with a normal gait; the right leg single stance was less stable than the left leg single stance
could squat fully but could not get up by herself

losses.description: Right hip pain and weakness requiring use of a stick when going out; needed crutches, wheelchair and walking frame for a period after the accident; limitation on walking more than 30 minutes.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Required bed rest at home until November 2004 and had to employ night and interim caretakers to take care of her daily needs during bed-rest period.
Both fractures healed up with mild deformity.
